notes: Temporary instrumentation adds fixed counters, clock reads and immediate/1Hz monitor snapshots. Reproduce with sender-controller-diagnostic.patch on 13cdebd; this is not a normal-release throughput result.
Two continuous 60-second 21G points with the harness's ordinary receiver-drain gap. Build/tests did not overlap load.
Align host-monotonic snapshot timestamps using each point's before/sent log snapshots; container /proc/uptime has a different origin.
Controller rates are outer bytes/s. Raw sample send/ACK intervals are not RTT. Blocked-request counts measure attempts, not elapsed time.

The first ACK spuriously enters ProbeRTT because Owner initialized Controller at time zero. Both controllers have returned to Startup before the first DATA load; this is not evidence of a pre-load full-bandwidth plateau.
Directions L->R/R->L; endpoint arrays L/R. Receiver sample goodput excludes drain; missing ratios include drain.100% CPU is one CPU.
TAP SKBs, queue drops and expired frames use different units and cannot be added into an exact frame-loss total.
These sweeps do not establish a CPU ceiling or either performance gate. Raw process/thread counters and per-flow records are retained.
